name: r2-private-uploads
title: Bounded private R2 attachments with tenant-scoped keys
description: Adds authenticated raw attachment uploads, streamed downloads, HEAD and deletion using an R2 binding. Actual body bytes are bounded; keys derive from the verified tenant and a server-generated UUID, and downloads are private attachments with no client-supplied metadata.
author: Coop <coop@xavalabs.com>

params.name: objectPrefix
params.description: Object namespace used only by this feature.

params.name: maxBytes
params.description: Per-request buffered attachment cap (1 byte to 8 MiB). Counted from actual bytes, not just Content-Length.

routes.description: Stream an attachment owned by the authenticated tenant.
Read attachment metadata without its body.
Delete an attachment in the authenticated tenant namespace.

agent.summary: Adds authenticated raw attachment uploads, streamed downloads, HEAD and deletion using an R2 binding. Actual body bytes are bounded; keys derive from the verified tenant and a server-generated UUID, and downloads are private attachments with no client-supplied metadata.
when_to_use: Bounded private R2 attachments with tenant-scoped keys
when_not_to_use: Small private attachments only: no public CDN, inline image rendering, multipart/resumable upload, listing, file scanning or total storage quota. Uploads buffer at most maxBytes; downloads stream. The host supplies verified tenant membership, rate limits, lifecycle policy and deletion cleanup.

adapt.title: Bind a private R2 bucket
adapt.do: Create bucketName and set the UPLOADS binding; leave public access and r2.dev disabled. A public bucket or custom domain would bypass application authorization.
adapt.check: Objects are readable only through the authenticated application route.

adapt.title: Mount routes with a verified tenant resolver
adapt.do: Mount uploadRoutes(resolveTenant) at {{kit.routePrefix}}. The resolver verifies the session/token and any organization membership, then returns a trusted tenant id or null. Never return a request-supplied tenant id without membership verification.
adapt.check: Other tenants receive 404 for a known upload id and cannot delete its bytes.

adapt.title: Set product limits and lifecycle
adapt.do: Choose maxBytes, rate-limit uploads, enforce any total tenant quota, and configure private bucket retention/account deletion cleanup. Send raw request bytes rather than multipart/form-data.
adapt.check: Oversized chunked uploads are 413 without creating an object; product quotas and cleanup are enforced by the host.
